name: Warp Talon

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

abilities.name: Warp Rift
abilities.text: The Warp Talon emerges from the Warp. All opponents of the Warp Talon must make a DN 3 Initiative Test or are Ambushed. Additionally, all opponents of the Warp Talon must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Empyrean Return
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Warp Talon disappears into the Warp. At the start of its next Turn, the Warp Talon may reappear using its BATTLECRY: Warp Rift.

abilities.name: Jump Pack
abilities.text: A Warp Talon may fly at double Speed by making a DN3 Pilot (A) Test, ignoring terrain. If they fail this test then their movement deviates according to the Scattering (W&G p.186) rules. A Complication on this test triggers a crash, and the Warp Talon suffers 1d3 Shock and falling damage (p.201)

abilities.name: Reality Slice
abilities.text: When this Threat successfully hits with a Wrath Critical in melee this Threat deals +2 Mortal Wounds, and 1D3 Shock.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Warp Talons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
